summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns bool(ref.startswith(self)) (prefix test, reference as receiver); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref == a stored term URI (node-type-aware, so plain strings and Literals are not members; rdf:_1 container properties are not members); _RDFNamespace inherits the closed hook. _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). NamespaceManager unchanged. In test/test_namespace.py, added tests to NamespacePrefixTest covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS closed positive/negative, non-URIRef negatives, and RDF closed positive and container negative. Tests were not run, per instructions. The test file changed on disk mid-task; I kept its current contents and only removed a duplicate assertion I had added.
